feature: Work Center Master with Calibration/Qualification Tracking

envDependencies.SAP_FIORI_URL: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_FIORI_URL} in navigation steps
envDependencies.SAP_USERNAME: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_USERNAME} in login steps
envDependencies.SAP_PASSWORD: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_PASSWORD} in login steps

TD-CS-060-001.name: Valid Work Center with Valid Calibration — Primary Happy Path
TD-CS-060-001.expectedOutcome: Work Center created with valid calibration status; eligible for capacity planning

TD-CS-060-002.name: Update Existing Work Center with New Calibration Date
TD-CS-060-002.expectedOutcome: Work Center calibration date updated successfully; calibration status remains valid

TD-CS-060-003.name: Alert Generated When Calibration Within Alert Lead-Time
TD-CS-060-003.expectedOutcome: PM Notification generated for Work Center; alert routed to Maintenance Planner

TD-CS-060-004.name: Batch Record Captures Work Center ID and Calibration Status at Production Confirmation
TD-CS-060-004.expectedOutcome: Batch Record updated with Work Center ID, Equipment Number, Calibration Status, and Timestamp

TD-CS-060-AP-001.name: Mark Work Center as Out of Service
TD-CS-060-AP-001.expectedOutcome: Work Center status changed to Out of Service; excluded from capacity planning

TD-CS-060-AP-002.name: Requalify Work Center and Re-Include in Capacity Planning
TD-CS-060-AP-002.expectedOutcome: Work Center calibration updated; status changed to Valid; re-included in capacity planning

TD-CS-060-AP-003.name: Configure Custom Alert Lead-Time
TD-CS-060-AP-003.expectedOutcome: Custom alert lead-time configured; alert trigger date calculated based on custom value

TD-CS-060-NEG-001.name: Attempt to Schedule Process Order on Work Center with Expired Calibration
TD-CS-060-NEG-001.expectedOutcome: SAP displays validation error: Work Center has expired calibration; operation NOT scheduled

TD-CS-060-NEG-002.name: Attempt to Schedule Process Order on Work Center Marked Out of Service
TD-CS-060-NEG-002.expectedOutcome: SAP displays validation error: Work Center is out of service; operation NOT scheduled

TD-CS-060-NEG-003.name: Enter Past Date as Calibration Expiration Date
TD-CS-060-NEG-003.expectedOutcome: SAP displays validation error: Calibration date cannot be in the past; Work Center NOT created

TD-CS-060-ERR-001.name: Missing Mandatory Field — Work Center ID
TD-CS-060-ERR-001.note: workCenterId intentionally empty to test mandatory field enforcement
TD-CS-060-ERR-001.expectedOutcome: SAP highlights Work Center ID field as mandatory; prevents submission

TD-CS-060-ERR-002.name: Missing Mandatory Field — Plant
TD-CS-060-ERR-002.note: plant intentionally empty to test mandatory field enforcement
TD-CS-060-ERR-002.expectedOutcome: SAP highlights Plant field as mandatory; prevents submission

TD-CS-060-ERR-003.name: Missing Mandatory Field — Work Center Category
TD-CS-060-ERR-003.note: workCenterCategory intentionally empty to test mandatory field enforcement
TD-CS-060-ERR-003.expectedOutcome: SAP highlights Work Center Category field as mandatory; prevents submission

TD-CS-060-ERR-004.name: Missing Mandatory Field — Equipment Number When Calibration Tracking Required
TD-CS-060-ERR-004.note: equipmentNumber intentionally empty to test conditional mandatory field enforcement when calibration tracking is enabled
TD-CS-060-ERR-004.expectedOutcome: SAP highlights Equipment Number field as required for calibration tracking; prevents submission

TD-CS-060-EDGE-001.name: Calibration Expiration Date Equals Today — Minimum Valid Boundary
TD-CS-060-EDGE-001.expectedOutcome: Work Center created with calibration date = today; status Valid (boundary test passed)

TD-CS-060-EDGE-002.name: Alert Lead-Time Equals 0 Days — Minimum Boundary
TD-CS-060-EDGE-002.expectedOutcome: Alert lead-time configured to 0 days; alert triggered only on expiration day

TD-CS-060-EDGE-003.name: Alert Lead-Time Equals 999 Days — Maximum Boundary
TD-CS-060-EDGE-003.expectedOutcome: Alert lead-time configured to 999 days; alert triggered 999 days before expiration

TD-CS-060-EDGE-004.name: Available Capacity Equals 1 Minute — Minimum Valid Boundary
TD-CS-060-EDGE-004.expectedOutcome: Work Center created with available capacity = 1 minute (minimum boundary test passed)

TD-CS-060-EDGE-005.name: Calibration Expiration Date Equals Exactly Alert Lead-Time Days from Today — Boundary Trigger
TD-CS-060-EDGE-005.expectedOutcome: Work Center created with calibration date exactly at alert threshold; alert triggered today (boundary test)

TD-CS-060-INT-001.name: Calibration Date in Equipment Master Propagates to Work Center Master — PM to PP Integration
TD-CS-060-INT-001.expectedOutcome: Work Center calibration date auto-populated from Equipment Master (PM-PP integration confirmed)

TD-CS-060-INT-002.name: Process Order Scheduling Engine Queries Work Center Calibration Status Before Assignment
TD-CS-060-INT-002.expectedOutcome: Scheduling engine accepts valid Work Center; rejects expired Work Center (PP-PP integration confirmed)

TD-CS-060-INT-003.name: Alert Notification Created in PM Notifications and Routed to Maintenance Planner
TD-CS-060-INT-003.expectedOutcome: PM Notification created and routed to Maintenance Planner (PP-PM integration confirmed)

TD-CS-060-INT-004.name: Batch Record Captures Equipment ID and Calibration Status from Work Center at Production Confirmation
TD-CS-060-INT-004.expectedOutcome: Batch Record captures Work Center ID, Equipment Number, Calibration Status, and Timestamp (PP-QM integration confirmed)

TD-CS-060-INT-005.name: Background Job Scans Work Centers and Generates Alerts Based on Configurable Lead-Time
TD-CS-060-INT-005.expectedOutcome: Background job scans Work Centers; generates alert for WC1 (within threshold); no alert for WC2 (outside threshold)
